data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Monday, September 7, 2026: Crypto investors on rate watch
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $80,351.40 on Monday, September 7, 2026, 0.7% higher than Sunday's opening price. As of 9:41 a.m. ET this morning, the price of bitcoin moved back to $79,349.91.
